title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1+PARKING SPACE IN BRYL
description_en: With a surface area of ​​98 m2, on the 1st floor in a building built in 2000, without an elevator. The apartment is furnished. It is located near the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and with immediate access to "Zhan Dark" Boulevard. The price includes a parking post with an area of ​​8 m2. The apartment has the possibility of perfect division into 2 apartments. With regular mortgage documentation.
